description: Use this to see the deterministic rules on one inbox, in the order they run. Read-only; requires auth and message_read. Input: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email). Returns {object:"list", data:[inbox_rule]}. Each rule has id, name, enabled, position, conditions, actions, stop_processing, match_count, last_matched_at, last_error, client_id, created_at, and updated_at. An inbox-scoped key for another inbox returns HTTP 404 inbox_not_found.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

name: cooper_list_rules

data.description: Items on this page, in the order the tool description gives.

actions.description: What happens to a matching message.

client_id.description: Caller idempotency key stored with the object, or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

enabled.description: True when the object is active.

id.description: Rule id. Pass it as rule_id.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

last_matched_at.description: ISO-8601 time of the last match, or null.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

position.description: Order the rule runs in. Lower runs first.

stop_processing.description: When true, later rules are skipped after a match.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object last changed.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

title: List inbox rules
